stanzas: Φῶς ἱλαρὸν ἁγίας δόξης ἀθανάτου Πατρός,
ἐλθόντες ἐπὶ τὴν ἡλίου δύσιν, ἰδόντες φῶς ἑσπερινόν,
—ὑμνοῦμεν Πατέρα, Υἱόν, καὶ ἅγιον Πνεῦμα, Θεόν.
Ἄξιόν σε ἐν πᾶσι καιροῖς ὑμνεῖσθαι φωναῖς αἰσίαις,
—Υἱὲ Θεοῦ, ζωὴν ὁ διδούς· διὸ ὁ κόσμος σὲ δοξάζει.
orig.credit: Anonymous Greek hymn; as quoted in Wikipedia's article

stanzas: Joyful light of the holy glory of the immortal Father,
having come to the setting of the sun, having seen the evening light,
—we hymn the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit, God.
It is fitting that you be hymned at all times with auspicious voices,
—Son of God, you who give life; therefore the world glorifies you.
Phōs hilaron hagias doxēs athanatou Patros,
elthontes epi tēn hēliou dysin, idontes phōs hesperinon,
—hymnoumen Patera, Huion, kai hagion Pneuma, Theon.
Axion se en pasi kairois hymneisthai phōnais aisiais,
—Huie Theou, zōēn ho didous; dio ho kosmos se doxazei.

notes: line 1.2: 'heavenly, holy, blessed' are genitive and agree with 'the Father' of line 1; 'Jesus Christ' is addressed.
Accents and breathings are not shown except the rough breathing (h); the diphthong υι is written ui (Huion, Huie).
